content: Dream, dream, dream. Dreams transform into thoughts and thoughts result in action. Dreams are not what you see in sleep, they are the things that do not let you sleep.
author: A. P. J. Abdul Kalam
explanation:
Dr. Kalam redefined the nature of dreaming for millions of youths across the world. A dream is not a passive, idle fantasy indulged in comfortable slumber; it is an electric, burning vision of what is possible that grips your heart and demands your total commitment. When a dream captures your imagination with moral purity, it inevitably crystallizes into clear strategies and unstoppable daily action.

Great achievements in human history were all forged in the furnace of an unyielding dream.
practicalInsight: Write down the boldest dream you have for your life on a card, place it where you see it daily, and take one concrete action toward it before sundown.
reflectionPrompt: What aspiration burns within you so intensely that you are willing to dedicate years of persistent work to bring it alive?
